Type: open bookcase with drawers

Materials: wood frame and shelves, satin nickel bar pulls
Colors: warm honey wood, silver
Shape: tall open frame with square posts, three open shelves, two stacked drawers, low bottom shelf, slightly tapered legs, gallery top rail, medium visual weight

product.name: Pinzon Hayes Shelf
product.description: Beautifully crafted shelving unit offers 2 drawers to maximize efficiency Solid birch construction with basswood veneer; brushed stainless steel handles Open front and sides for easy accessibility; easy assembly; holds up to 100 pounds Coordinates with the Pinzon Hayes Office Furniture Collection; tiki brown finish Measures 30 inches wide by 14 inches deep by 64-1/2 inches high
